status: offline exploratory extension after reviewing first-trial results; no activation or deployment
rationale: first trial reached11/21 within1pp and2/6 in later replay; test whether a global line hides local response, without changing abnormal-label fences or discarding failures
outlier_rule: unchanged one-pass training-label Tukey fences; never based on prediction errors
primary_availability: observed_at and created_at before local prediction date midnight
secondary_availability: both timestamps before prediction time; label revision availability unknown
primary_group: three systems, strict-only training, preceding_day, strict validation
primary_score: normal validation hit1 count/denominator; also all samples, exclusions and prediction coverage
selection: earlier selection dates only: highest normal hit1 fraction then lowest normal MAE then declared order; later replay never used to choose
recent_order: latest sample times among available clean rows within24h; no recent data: bias model falls back to unshifted Huber, recent median model falls back to clean median
neighbor_rule: nearest5 available clean training inputs; level-only or normalized level+coal squared distance; ties newest sample then id; median or training-neighborhood densest +/-1 interval, no search over k or scale
frozen_selection: algorithm selection uses earlier scores only; parameters update from previously available labels during later replay
normal_subset_caveat: normal status uses validation label retrospectively; never known to online predictor; normal and all scores both shown
alignment_caveat: same t-90s received_at matching; source clock and physical material alignment unverified
prior_data_use: first trial and previous tail already inspected; this extension is exploratory, not independent validation
